notes: GAAP county, governmental activities only, no business-type funds (business_type null). Receipts/disbursements from p6 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column. Homestead taxes categorized as intergovernmental/state aid. Payments in lieu of tax is 1,571,018 on p6 (1,571,017 on p4). Debt_proceeds = leases + subscriptions issued (both shown as other financing sources). Balance sheet uses p3 government-wide Statement of Net Position (only a Governmental Activities column, which is the total primary government). ending_cash is the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p5) cash and pooled investments, total column; restricted assets of 54,143,934 are separate. Detail: General Fund recorded from the budget-basis schedule (pp7-8, budget basis differs from GAAP: actual revenues 354,743,980 vs GAAP general fund 317,506,967; the report prints these as is). Road, Health Center and DC Justice Center budget schedules pp9-11 recorded; nonmajor detail uses the Total Nonmajor Special Revenue Funds column on p13 (p12 per-fund columns not repeated) plus the Total Nonmajor Debt Service Funds column on p14 (Debt Service, Correction Bond, Public Safety Bond); together they equal the p14 Total Nonmajor Governmental Funds column (52,241,505 revenue, 43,748,013 expenditures), matching the p6 Nonmajor column. Road Fund budget-schedule actual fund balance and GAAP differ; not reconciled. Pages 15-19 (schedules 16-17 statistical) have no financial data. Pages 1-2 (original report pp4-5, added by the v7 re-trim) are table-of-contents pages with no financial data. Read pages 1-19 of 19 Page 14 (source p95, added by re-trim) added the nonmajor debt service funds' revenue, debt service and transfer lines.
